nodes.label: For the three-second following check, begin counting when the leading vehicle passes a fixed landmark and do not reach that landmark before three seconds have elapsed.

nodes.label: Adjust speed to weather, traffic and road conditions while staying at or below the posted maximum; going too quickly or too slowly can be hazardous.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning condition-based speed stays below maximum; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning driver, vehicle and environment affect stopping; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning rest and breaks help avoid drowsy driving; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning keep visual attention moving; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning fog requires early communication; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning wind exposure can require steering correction; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning high wind restricts house-trailer hauling; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Before winter driving, remove snow and ice, clear and defrost all windows, use nonfreezing washer fluid and make headlights and rear lamps visible.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning clear vehicle and windows before travel; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning vehicle maintenance supports winter operation; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.
